scope: Actual north Rocher woodland, mapped cliff line, twelve missing crest footprints and pedestrian paths. Existing elements are preserved by type/id. No road or racing geometry imported. Individual reconstructed trees are not mapped positions.
height_limits: Tagged storeys retained with shared3.4m conversion. Untagged historic houses use explicitly estimated3storeys; chapel height and roof form estimated from municipal/confraternity photographs, not a survey.
additional_exclusion: Above-ground Avenue de la Porte Neuve165636031 is retained only to preserve its visual paving beneath the cliffs. Two-lane tag supports an estimated6m exclusion width, not a native road/collision change.
